fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.6 is a read-only OCum Ascended 3D diagnostic build: network synchronization for ocumvagmesh/ocumanmesh remains disabled, while OStim Together now queries OActor.IsObjectEquipped plus the OCum backing-armor worn state for every actor in each active OStim thread every 250 ms, including dynamic STR proxies. Results are written directly to OStimTogether.log so hidden or stale equip-object states can be identified without modifying scene state. Supported RaceMenu CumOverlays synchronization, local OCum rendering, PPA, scene anchors and alignment are unchanged.
